Terms

PicturaAI is free to use. These are the few rules that come with it, in plain words.

Last updated 16 November 2026

A free service, as it is

PicturaAI is a free, open-source project with no accounts, no payments and no watermark. It is provided as it is, without any warranty. It runs on a free hosting plan, so it can be slow to wake up, busy, or occasionally unavailable, and features can change or stop without notice. Keep your own copies of anything you care about: “My gallery” lives only in your browser and disappears if you clear its data.

Your photos stay yours

You keep all rights to the photos you upload and to the paintings you make from them. We don’t claim any ownership and we don’t use your photos for anything except making the picture you asked for. How they are handled is explained on the privacy page.

Only upload what you may use

  • Upload photos and paintings only if you own them or have permission to use them.
  • Be careful with photos of other people, and respect their privacy.
  • Don’t use PicturaAI for anything illegal, to harass anyone, or to create content that sexualises minors.
  • Don’t try to overload, break into or scrape the service.

The paintings and your results

Every painting in the collection is in the public domain, and you are free to use the pictures you make with them, including commercially. Sources and licences are on the credits page. If you use a painting of your own as the style, the rights in that painting still apply to the result, so make sure you are allowed to use it.

Fair use limits

To keep the free server available to everyone, the number of requests from each IP address is limited (for example, 10 server paintings and 5 described styles a minute), and the number of generated styles per day is capped. If you hit a limit, wait a minute and try again. Painting on your own device has no limit.

Changes

These terms may change as PicturaAI changes. When they do, the date at the top changes too. The code is under the MIT License on GitHub, where you can also report problems.
